reason: £300 is two percent of what I earn in a year, and I'd be handing it to a brand new seller with no reviews. I can get used sets on Marketplace for less and look at them in person first.
objection: No reviews, so I've no idea if the fit check is real or if I'm stuck with wheels that don't fit. The 7-day return only works if they're unmarked, and once I've tried them on the car that's a grey area. And collection from home means a stranger turning up.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real photos of the actual set and a few genuine local reviews, plus a written fit guarantee with a full refund if they don't fit, at around £200 a set.
